comment: The Haro v0.29 conformance floor, written BEFORE the court that passes it (the W discipline: fixtures first, prose second). v0.29 is WC1 of the second charge of the constitution desk (the six carried weaves, 2026-11-02): five of the six -- resilience (W1.5), observability (W2.2, W2.3), temporal_integrity (W5.2), learnability (W7.4) and structural_integrity (W8.5) -- are judged at the declaring altitude with no new seat, each rule an article's condition read at the weave's severity; W1.2 and W7.1 hold by construction; cost_awareness stays refused by name. The rules, their sort and the readings are in ZIN-WEAVES-INVENTORY.md; the account is GRAMMAR.md. A6 is v0.25's A1 unchanged: nothing v0.28 accepted is refused here but a weave name this rung now judges.

accepts.name: the five weaves the court now judges, all constitutional, in a world that satisfies each: a chain, a voice with codes, a gate whose policy points are no model's
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE clinic AS (VERSION "0.29", GRAMMAR "0.29", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".clinic") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION patient AS (VERB "PATIENT", SEATS [file_no: text, ward: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (SAYS [patient: "{name}, file {file_no}."]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFUSAL unknown_verb AS (MESSAGE "The verb set is closed", CODE "UNKNOWN_VERB") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT one_file AS (ON patient, WHEN "earlier patient where file_no = this.file_no", MESSAGE "two patients share a file", CODE "ONE_FILE") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE clinic AS (POINTS [patient.ward: knob, patient.file_no: policy], FLOOR [patient.ward: llm, patient.file_no: trusted]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [explainability, visible_state, predictable_authority], WEAVES [resilience: constitutional, observability: constitutional, temporal_integrity: constitutional, learnability: constitutional, structural_integrity: constitutional]) RATIONALE "x"

DEFINE DECLARATION patient AS (VERB "PATIENT", SEATS [file_no: text, ward: text]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: v0.25's A1 unchanged: the clinic under all six articles and both original weaves is accepted as before, and prints none of the new lines
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE clinic AS (VERSION "0.25", GRAMMAR "0.25", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".clinic") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU holders AS (WORDS [the_clinic, the_ministry, the_insurer]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU wards AS (WORDS [maternity, surgery, outpatients]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION patient AS (VERB "PATIENT", SEATS [full_name: text, file_no: text, ward: wards]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION registry AS (VERB "REGISTRY", SEATS [held_by: holders, entered_through: flow]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFUSAL unknown_verb AS (MESSAGE "The verb set is closed", CODE "UNKNOWN_VERB") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE clinic AS (POINTS [patient.full_name: field, patient.ward: knob], FLOOR [patient.full_name: external, patient.ward: trusted]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (SAYS [patient: "{name} (file {file_no}) is on {ward}.", flow: "{name} is a flow.", registry: "{name} is held by {held_by}, entered through {entered_through}."], REFUSES "Stopped at line {line}: {message} ({cites})") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [explainability, reversibility, visible_state, predictable_authority, organizational_sovereignty, trust_hierarchy], ZONE registry, SOVEREIGN held_by, MOVEMENT entered_through, WEAVES [sovereignty: constitutional, privacy: constitutional], REGIME gdpr, PERSONAL [patient.full_name]) RATIONALE "the whole constitution, with its first two weaves"
